page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page, in stanzas numbered in the left margin of the text. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Nothing in the right margin. Handwritten-looking gathering mark at the bottom right. The strip at the far left is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: 13 [?] Romanum signans ascendit bestia regnum, Quod simul & terras oceanumque regit. Altera consurgit blasphemo bestia vultu, Quam si Pontificem dixeris esse, licet.

14 Agnum deducunt cultores agmine casto. Angelicos audit aure patente sonos. Ille fidem tradit: Babylonia fata minatur, Alter, & immanis dira periclaferæ [?]. Iam natura cadit feruenti tempore messis, Et spumant musto squalida praela novo.
15 Apparent septem non læto corde ministri. Tradidit his septem verbera dira Deus. Iamque Deum celebrans resonanti voce supremum, Vicerunt tristis qui mala monstra ferae.
16 Cœlesti septem venientes arce ministri Septem pœnarum pocula plana gerunt. Hæc simul effundunt, his bestia tangitur ingens, Quæ turpes ranas ore patente vomit.
17 Immani vehitur meretrix obscœna dracone, Aurato calice mixta venena ferens. Cuius in immensum trepidanda potentia surgit, Hanc cupiunt reges, hanc cupiuntque duces.
18 Vasta ruunt magnæ Babylonis mœnia, clamat Angelus, hei nimium mœnia tanta iacent. Mercantes lugent, summi lugentque Monarchæ, Quos duxit nimium tam lupa fœda diu.
19 Ultima narrantur cœlestis prælia pugnæ, Quæ ferus æthereo concidit ense draco. Iam pereunt quotquot Dominum impugnare parabant, Mergitur ardenti bestia sæva lacu.
20 Clauditur in tristem Satanas crudelis auernum, Qui redeat, cum sunt sæcula lapsa decem. Panduntur summi sinuosa volumina cœli, Defunctos fortis iudicat ipse Deus.
21 Ecce novum cœlum, pariter nova & omnia vidi, Et nova de summo mœnia lapsa polo. Pingitur hac nobis victrix Ecclesia forma, Quæ fortis iuncta est sponsa pudica Deo.
22 Viventis cernit manantes fluminis undas, Ac urbis pingit iura celanda nova [?].

page.notes: The first verse number reads as "3" with a cut-off tens digit; probably 13, marked [?]. The printed spelling "periclaferæ" in verse 14 is unclear and marked [?]. The final word of verse 22 ("nova") is followed by a mark that may be a hyphen or a stain; marked [?]. "vrbis" in verse 22 is read as urbis. The signature "Z. iij" at the bottom right looks partly handwritten and may not be a printed gathering mark. The left strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and is excluded.
